status: All 36 finite-work attempts passed, with six rows each occupying every position once.

scope.work: The same exact firmware-free ROM executes 50 million fixed iterations and 350 million statically verified loop instructions, independently of virtual time.
scope.primary: Spawn through the full END token, including startup and work.
scope.roi: Full START-token receipt through full END-token receipt. This includes checksum formatting, bounded UART polling and socket transport, so it is not solely arithmetic-loop execution time.
scope.timestamps: The launch is relative time zero. END is the stored spawn-to-END duration. START is derived by subtracting the stored ROI duration. These are relative marker endpoints, not invented per-trial UTC timestamps.
scope.ordinary_state: After END timing, stock capture waits for actual permanent halt at the known tail and requires restored EAX, zero ECX, stack pointer and interrupt state. A late QMP stop is not an exact END coordinate.
scope.sim_state: Sim stops exactly at authenticated request raw plus one, before epilogue register restoration. Saved stack registers and the independent RAM record preserve the arithmetic oracle.
scope.memory: All 36 full 64 MiB RAM captures share the same digest and record. All 12 Sim captures share every one of the nine strict native witness fields and match the earlier smoke reference.
scope.delivery: The readonly ROM request exercises pending/empty callback admission, not occupied reply delivery. Public reply continuation qualification is separate.
scope.comparison: Direct original/final finite-work ratios are independent results and are not added to Linux or microbenchmark percentages.
scope.balance: One complete forward rotation cycle; no reverse-cycle observations or retries.

timing_window.scope: Root-coordinated team quiet window, with no Firecracker observed by the parent at the start. Whole-host idleness is not established.
timing_window.per_trial_utc: The frozen runners did not record individual trial UTC endpoints. Stored durations and ordering are exact; file modification times are not substituted as timing endpoints.

raw_results.scope:
Measure identical finite ROM work across distinct TCG clock contracts.

The same ROM bytes and iteration count execute in every row. Spawn-to-END and
START-to-END socket receipt intervals are reported separately. UART polling,
checksum formatting and transport latency are included in the latter interval;
only the seven-instruction arithmetic loop has a static retired-work count.
Sim's secondary authenticated stop is exact. Stock stops after END and its
optional replay count is not the exact END instruction coordinate.
